newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt realty firm nine-mnth 96/7 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt realty firm nine-mnth 96/7 profit.

text.p: Egypt realty firm Development and Engineering Consultancy raised net profits for the first nine months of financial 1996/7 to 9.19 million pounds ($2.71 million) from 5.04 million in the same 1995/6 period, company sources said on Wednesday.
They said the firm's net profits for the whole of 96/7 were forecast at 12.5 million, up from 12.04 million in 95/6. Dividends for 96/7 were also expected at 3.15 pounds a share compared to 2.72.
The state had also said it expected the 96/7 profit to increase to 12.587 million but forecast the dividend to be lower at 2.85 pounds a share.

Development and Engineering Consultancy went majority private on Wednesday after the state-run Holding Company for Housing, Cinema and Tourism sold 883,659 shares or all its stake in the firm for 32.3 million pounds.
